# A held right press, a settings overlay that steps a value (turning motion on), and shared borders toggled with tiling on: the retile starts a slide, and the pane keeps its emulator at the old size until the slide lands, two cells under its drawable. Not a product bug: the model clock does not advance a slide, and the oracle judged the frame in the middle of it.

chord "m"
press 0 0 2
overlay-open 1
press 8 27 1
new-pane
shared-borders
tiling
key "ctrl+c"
key "left"
tiling
shared-borders
